label: Core multi-factor (optimised)
blurb: The IC-weighted family score turned into a book by an optimiser: expected return less risk (a market, sector and ten-style risk model) less the market's trading and borrow costs, dollar-, sector- and beta-neutral, each name capped at 5% or a day's traded value at $100m, re-solved monthly from last month's book. Shown under the sector-neutral construction; the weights are the optimiser's, not equal.
literature: Grinold and Kahn (2000), Active Portfolio Management
